people.name: Israel

people.name: Moab_Plains
people.line: Region east of the Jordan River, opposite Jericho

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: The children of Israel wept for Moses in the plains of Moab thirty days, until the days of weeping in the mourning for Moses were ended.
translations.bsb: The Israelites grieved for Moses in the plains of Moab thirty days, until the time of weeping and mourning for Moses came to an end.
translations.kjv: And the children of Israel wept for Moses in the plains of Moab thirty days: so the days of weeping and mourning for Moses were ended.
translations.asv: And the children of Israel wept for Moses in the plains of Moab thirty days: so the days of weeping in the mourning for Moses were ended.
